name: week
title: Orchard week
subtitle: Recorded holds and work to review, not harvest clearance

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from orchard_attention order by priority,block

sections.title: Pick planning
sections.sql: select code,block,planned_pick,pick_after,enter_after,decision from block_readiness order by code

sections.title: Block performance, all recorded history
sections.sql: select code,block,kg,kg_per_hectare,bins,round(hours,2) hours,labour_cost,labour_cost_per_kg from block_performance order by code

sections.title: Water allocation, all recorded history
sections.sql: select code,block,irrigation_litres,litres_per_kg from block_performance order by code
